vi: Chọn Memorystore tier BASIC (single-node standalone) cho cache ephemeral rẻ, STANDARD_HA (primary+replica cross-zone) cho session store production.
Hiểu availability tradeoff: BASIC mất dữ liệu khi node restart, STANDARD_HA tự failover nhưng giá gấp đôi — chọn đúng usecase.
Thiết kế Redis eviction policy (maxmemory-policy) để xác định là cache (LRU evict) hay store (NOCLEAN no evict).
Connect Memorystore qua private IP + Private Service Access (peering) từ GCE/GKE, không có endpoint public trên GCP.
Sử dụng read_endpoint trên STANDARD_HA để tách read traffic sang replica, scale đọc mà không tăng primary load.
en: Choose Memorystore tier BASIC (single-node standalone) for cheap ephemeral cache, STANDARD_HA (primary+replica cross-zone) for production session store.
Understand the availability tradeoff: BASIC loses data on node restart, STANDARD_HA auto-failovers but costs 2x — pick the right use case.
Design Redis eviction policy (maxmemory-policy) to determine if it's a cache (LRU evict) or store (NOCLEAN no evict).
Connect Memorystore via private IP + Private Service Access (peering) from GCE/GKE, no public endpoint on GCP.
Use read_endpoint on STANDARD_HA to split read traffic to replicas, scaling reads without increasing primary load.
